title: Convert repo into self-contained uv skill

observation: Development work should use a structured worklog, prefer simple changes, and validate with existing tests when possible.
Use structured worklog tools as source of truth; record meaningful observations, add tasks before implementation, and finish/cancel all tasks before completion.

README currently presents the project as a PyPI-installable CLI, recommends `uv tool install google-search-console-cli`, includes `uv tool` upgrade/uninstall instructions, and has a Publishing section for PyPI workflows.
The skill manifest currently lives under a nested skills/google-search-console directory and requires an installed `gsc` command in prerequisites; command examples use `gsc` directly.
Repository has a PyPI publishing workflow triggered by version tags and workflow_dispatch, building distributions and publishing with trusted publishing.
Setup script already uses uv but runs `uv sync --extra dev`, checks `.venv/bin/gsc`, and then invokes `uv run gsc auth login`; this can be simplified for no-install uv-run usage.

Project defines the `gsc` script entry point (`gsc_cli.cli:cli`) and dev extra for pytest, so `uv run --project <skill-root> gsc ...` and `uv run --project <skill-root> pytest` can execute from a copied skill folder without global installation.

title: Move the Google Search Console skill manifest to the repository root and rewrite it for self-contained uv-run usage.

Commit the completed changes with the structured worklog.

content: Starting root SKILL.md relocation/update. Plan is to make the directory containing SKILL.md the skill root and make every command example use `uv run --project "$SKILL_DIR" gsc ...` so the CLI does not need a global install.

Created root `SKILL.md` with the `google-search-console` skill metadata and rewrote usage guidance so all examples run through `uv run --project "$SKILL_DIR" gsc ...`; noted the short `uv run gsc ...` form when already inside the skill directory.
Removing the PyPI publishing workflow and the old nested `skills/google-search-console/SKILL.md` location now that the skill manifest is rooted at the repository top level.
Removed `.github/workflows/publish.yml` and the old nested `skills/google-search-console/SKILL.md` from git. The only skill manifest is now the root-level `SKILL.md`.
Updating user-facing documentation and setup script to remove PyPI/global installation paths and make `uv run` the standard execution path.

Rewrote `README.md` around the self-contained skill workflow, removing PyPI/global install, upgrade, uninstall, and publishing instructions. Updated `scripts/setup.sh` to locate the repository/skill root and call `uv run --project "$SKILL_DIR" gsc auth login ...` directly without `uv sync`, `.venv` checks, or `--skip-install`.
Validating uv-run command execution from the project path and running the existing pytest suite with the dev extra.

observation: The self-contained uv command resolves the root project and exposes the `gsc` CLI command list successfully.
Existing test suite passes under the uv-run workflow: 36 tests passed.
Updated setup script passes shell syntax validation.

content: Validated `uv run --project "$PWD" gsc --help`, `uv run gsc --help`, `uv run --project "$PWD" --extra dev pytest` (36 passed), and `bash -n scripts/setup.sh`. Reviewed the diff to confirm README/setup changes and PyPI workflow removal.

Follow-up hardening for the setup script: normalized the client-secret path to an absolute path after validating it exists so `uv run --project "$SKILL_DIR" ...` remains correct even if uv executes from a different working directory.
Preparing final commit by staging source/doc/script changes, deleted PyPI workflow/nested skill file, new root SKILL.md, and the structured worklog.
Final commit is ready: source/docs/scripts and removals have been reviewed, validation passed, and this terminal worklog state will be staged with the code changes.
